anchor: The demand signals are not derivable from one another under any of the relationships tested here: constant-fraction scaling, rank correlation, and lagged linear cross-correlation
claim_text: Demand signals cannot be derived from each other using constant-fraction scaling, rank correlation, or lagged linear cross-correlation.

anchor: At window level, the image--generation cross-correlation peaks sharply at lag zero with no lead
claim_text: At window level, image-generation cross-correlation peaks at lag zero with no lead.

anchor: Below the one-minute scale, all signals reach a white shot-noise floor: finer-grained inputs add noise, not information
claim_text: Below one-minute resolution, all signals reach a white shot-noise floor; finer granularity adds noise not information.

anchor: The trace carries no image resolutions (counts only), no session or user identifiers, and no latency or completion-time ground truth (it is arrival-side only)
claim_text: The trace lacks image resolutions, session/user IDs, and latency/completion-time ground truth (arrival-side only).

anchor: the two pools' demands decouple statistically and saturate an order of magnitude apart on steady traffic
claim_text: The vision and language pool demands decouple statistically and saturate at significantly different levels under steady traffic.

anchor: with the encoder pool failing its tail bound at the trace's own recorded rate --- invisibly to rate- and utilization-based monitors
claim_text: The encoder pool fails its tail bound at the recorded rate, undetected by rate- and utilization-based monitors.

anchor: covariates are nearly irrelevant at provisioning cadence
claim_text: Covariates have negligible impact at provisioning cadence.

anchor: The language pool runs under calibrated engine timing (a Dynamo discrete-event simulation on AIC H100 timing, not real H100) whose delta against the simulator's default polynomial is quantified, including a burst-window SLA violation the polynomial misses
claim_text: The language pool simulation quantifies timing differences against the default polynomial, including an SLA violation missed by the polynomial.
